jobs.title: MERN Stack Developer
jobs.description: Build full-stack features with MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. The employer seeks roughly four to five years of MERN work, daily AI-assisted coding practice, backend/API depth and working Docker/CI/CD/cloud skills. The office is in Lahore. Degree education is not required; TypeScript, Next.js, relational data and production LLM features are useful additions.

jobs.title: MERN Stack Developer

Requirements include at least one year of relevant work, OOP understanding, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Node.js, database familiarity, Git, clear documentation and communication. jobs.title: Frontend React/Ember
jobs.description: A mid-level, full-time frontend role on a fitness studio management SaaS platform. Work covers customer-facing features, APIs, code improvement, tests and documentation with product and engineering colleagues. The posting asks for two-plus years of web development, agile work, React/JavaScript or related technologies, CI/CD, GitHub/Bitbucket and clear collaboration. Related stack experience and willingness to learn are accepted; a completed degree is not listed.
